_comment: Curated outreach-channel registry (question-router plan §5.7). Static knowledge artifact, refreshed ~monthly like geo_playbook.md / qc_sitemaps.json. feasibility: open (self-serve channel exists) | gated (application/approval required) | closed (no direct channel - earn the slot indirectly).

reddit.com.mechanism: Post authentic expert answers / host an AMA as a named QC account.

reputation: Reply from a named QC account, not anonymously - correcting the record only works if it's visibly QC saying it.
Acknowledge the specific concern before countering it; a defensive first line reads as spin.
Disclose the affiliation in the reply itself ("I work at QC...") - undisclosed brand replies get called out and downvoted.
Link out only if asked or if it directly substantiates the correction - don't turn a correction into a pitch.
discovery: Answer the question on its own terms first; QC only belongs in the reply if it's a genuine, relevant answer.
Check the subreddit's self-promotion rule (sidebar/wiki) before naming QC - some cap it at once per week or require mod approval.
Favor a comment on an existing thread over a new post - existing threads already have the search/AI-citation traction.
Build karma/history in the subreddit before the first QC mention where possible; a brand-new account naming a brand reads as an ad.

restricted_subreddits._comment: Subreddits a real outreach attempt confirmed ban self-promotion outright (rule text quoted from the sidebar/wiki at the time), keyed by subreddit name (lowercase, no r/). get_reddit_targets() in api/queries/cited_urls.py flags any thread in one of these as restricted rather than a plain 'answer & get discovered' opportunity. Add an entry whenever outreach hits a rule like this.

smallbusiness.rule: No business promotion posts are allowed - promote your business in the weekly Promote-your-business thread only. Also scoped to small businesses specifically; QC likely doesn't fit that definition either.
smallbusiness.mechanism: Post only in the pinned weekly promo thread, if QC qualifies as 'small business' there at all.

smallbusinessuk.rule: Same rule as r/smallbusiness - no business promotion posts outside the weekly promote-your-business thread, scoped to small businesses.
smallbusinessuk.mechanism: Post only in the pinned weekly promo thread, if QC qualifies as 'small business' there at all.

quora.com.mechanism: Answer relevant questions from a verified QC expert profile.

facebook.com.mechanism: Participate in relevant groups as a named QC presence; no anonymous posts.

coursera.org.mechanism: Apply to Coursera's partner/content program (approval required).

udemy.com.mechanism: Publish QC-branded introductory courses on the platform.

classcentral.com.mechanism: Submit QC courses to the Class Central catalog.

coursereport.com.mechanism: Claim/create the QC school profile; solicit alumni reviews.

careerkarma.com.mechanism: Request a school listing/partnership (editorial approval required).

switchup.org.mechanism: Claim the QC school listing; solicit verified reviews.

g2.com.mechanism: Claim/create the QC vendor profile; solicit reviews.

capterra.com.mechanism: Claim/create the QC vendor profile; solicit reviews.

trustpilot.com.mechanism: Claim the QC business profile; invite reviews.

wikipedia.org.mechanism: No direct edits (COI). Earn a citation by publishing a source editors can reference.

wikidata.org.mechanism: No promotional edits. Ensure QC's structured facts exist in citable primary sources.

britannica.com.mechanism: Not reachable. Benchmark the authority; align QC content.

gov_tld.mechanism: Not reachable. Benchmark the authority; align QC content.
